name: AWS EKS Terraform Lab
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euxo pipefail; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip jq curl wget; if ! command -v kind >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.20.0/kind-linux-amd64; sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/kind /usr/local/bin/kind; fi; if ! command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/yq https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/latest/download/yq_linux_amd64; sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/yq /usr/local/bin/yq; fi; if ! command -v flux >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/releases/latest/download/flux_linux_amd64.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin; fi; python3 --version; kind version; yq --version; flux --version'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip; fi; if ! command -v kind >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.20.0/kind-linux-amd64 && sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/kind /usr/local/bin/kind; fi; if ! command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/yq https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/latest/download/yq_linux_amd64 && sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/yq /usr/local/bin/yq; fi; if ! command -v flux >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/releases/latest/download/flux_linux_amd64.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin; fi'
